name: Dual Channeling
body:
You can channel both negative and positive energy.

Prerequisite: Cha 13, channel energy class feature, worshiper of a neutral god.

Benefit: You can channel negative and positive energy. You must choose which type of energy you are channeling each time you channel energy.

In addition, if you have the ability to spontaneously cast cure or inflict spells, you can now cast either.

Normal: You must choose whether to channel either negative or positive energy when you acquire the ability.
